title: Flow Field
blurb: Organic ribbons drifting along a simplex-noise vector field.

title: Contour Grid
blurb: Topographic bands undulating like breathing terrain.

title: Moiré
blurb: Two gratings of straight lines in one disc, rocking so broad moiré bands sweep across it.
safeZone: outside the disc, widest on the left
anchor: pinned band at the pivot, left of the disc's centre

title: Orbitals
blurb: A tilted ring of hairline arcs, each turning at its own rate, whose overlaps gather into one bright crescent that travels slowly round.
anchor: crescent on the ring's near side, lower centre, travelling slowly round

title: Grain Field
blurb: Fine drifting grain — the quietest piece, good behind text.

title: Wireframe Lattice
blurb: One finite lattice sheet with crisp edges, floating tilted in space and flexing, its fold catching the light where it turns edge-on.
anchor: fold crest, upper right, travelling across the sheet

title: Longwave
blurb: A band of hairlines riding one long wave, pinching together at its nodes.
anchor: tightest node, just right of centre

title: Relay
blurb: A canopy of branching hairlines grown from one root, a pulse climbing to the tips.

title: Infall
blurb: Hairline streamlines spiralling into one small, bright core.

title: Mooring
blurb: One rope of twisted hairlines rising into a single loose loop; the crossing glows.

title: Funnel
blurb: A funnel seen side-on: stacked hairline ellipses narrowing to one bright tip, slowly twisting.

title: Rainfall
blurb: Sparse vertical streaks falling at their own speed, gathered in a veil that leaves the left third quiet.

title: Lacuna
blurb: Broken caustic arcs gather around an off-centre calm zone.
anchor: outermost arc's densest crossing, right of centre

title: Parallax
blurb: Parallel diagonal lines part around an unseen volume, near strands heavier than the finer distant ones.
anchor: near lines bending tightest around the invisible volume

title: Cipher Bloom
blurb: A compressed oblique band of shifting glyph fragments, drawing a small bright core along its own length.
safeZone: top and bottom thirds, clear of the band
anchor: core, drifting along the band's centre

title: Driftwork
blurb: Tangent-aligned ellipse links follow two crossing currents, brightening by accumulation where they meet.

title: Pleat
blurb: Two folded bands of ivory marks, divided by a clean cut of empty space where they don't touch.
anchor: crease, where the two bands meet

title: Globe
blurb: A tilted sphere drawn only in parallel latitude slices, with no meridians, crowding and brightening toward one lit limb.

title: Dune
blurb: One wind-cut ridge built from film grain, its face caught by a low raking light and crossed by faint ripples.

title: Swell
blurb: A single ocean swell rising on a diagonal, drawn in halftone dots whose size carries the light on its face.
